body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on '2006 CES') -- <Visual News> (Picture 1,2: Las Vegas night view and casino. International CES 2006 is being held in this dazzling city from January 5 to January 8(local time))

Las Vegas, the world-famous city for casino and tourism, is the very place where ‘International CES 2006’ is being held from January 5th (local time) to January 8th. CES 2006, organized by CEA(Consumer Electronics Association) is one of the preeminent exhibitions in the world together with CeBIT and E3.

2,500 exhibitors from 110 countries will be displaying their latest digital devices and entertainment, wireless and mobile technologies according to about 30 product categories. Visitors are limited to consumer electronics industry-related people and press.

(Picture 3,4,5: Sands Expo, one of the exhibition hall of CES 2006. The pictures were taken on January 3rd, 13:40(local time). Exhibitors were busy in preparing their booth before the show begins on January 5th)

Seven AVING reporters are currently staying in Las Vegas, and they will be there till the end of the show to deliver the news about the latest products and technologies of CES 2006 with vivid photos in real time. Not only the news about world-class companies of Asian counties such as Korea, Taiwan, China, and Japan but also for small- and middle-sized companies will be delivered, which are not relatively known yet in the market but retain prominent products and technologies.
Exclusive coverage of CES 2006 will continue throughout the show in real time from AVING and AVING global news network.
< AVING Special Report Team for 2006 International CES: Editor & Publisher, Brain Park, Joshua Shim, Rose Kim, Yoojin Kim / IK Kim, Alliah Seo correspondents of AVING to CES / edited by Daniel Sirh >
